what_it_does: PartIR is a tool that helps machine learning engineers split large neural network computations across multiple computers or accelerators. Modern AI models must combine multiple parallelization strategies (distributing data batches, splitting model weights, coordinating optimizer updates) but existing systems make these choices tangled and hard to reason about. PartIR treats each strategy as a composable rewriting rule on the computation graph, enabling systematic exploration and verification of different parallelization approaches.
